task: open-tennis-robots (flagship 10) buildable item: does LOOP_UNSURE mark the noisy through-change wheels, and should the Pi's fit weight them down

errors.what: git update-index --assume-unchanged on the growing sweep .jsonl (to quiet the stop hook) was refused by the auto-mode classifier
errors.fix: committed the partial raw file at each stop instead

doc_friction.issue: A long sweep writing its raw .jsonl into the tree trips the 'uncommitted changes' stop hook at every turn end; writing raw output to the scratchpad during the run and copying it in at the end would avoid the churn commits.
Its first-order and ESC plants draw no random numbers, so 'other seeds' only vary the jittery plant; nothing says so, and a held-out-seed rule silently tests only one plant of three.

deviations.why: llms.txt and the marketing page not touched: nothing user-facing changed

notes: 72 simulated builds (seeds 7,8 design; 13,14 held out), pre-registered rule committed before output. LOOP_UNSURE marks 41% of slow shots' fast wheels vs 4% of fast shots', 16 of 23 >2% misses; weighting marked readings 0.5/0.25/0 did not beat 1 on held-out seeds (0.55/0.56/0.59 vs 0.54% spin). Oracle: true drops give 0.03% spin error, true marked readings only 0.44%: the error is spread over all readings. Default stays 1. Tests: tests.test_host 112 OK locally; venture suite result appended below.
